doc: world/onboarding-ui.md is canonical for behavior + copy. This file is the machine-readable mirror: journey stages, persona fork, tour beats, handle rules, pack ladder, first-ask variants, checklist contract, exit states, analytics hooks, and the never-list. Prices adopt rw-monetization-plan-2026-09-22 §2 (PROPOSAL — do not contradict in player-facing copy).

stages.gate: none — default state; watching never requires account, credits, or dismissal of anything
persona fork on the welcome card: 'just watching' vs 'might reach in' — equal weight, both keep the free feed; fork changes emphasis, never access
offered by welcome/fork card; self-dismisses once the viewer has scrolled the feed
watcher-fork landing after the tour: 'you're set' card; setup steps remain available but unpushed
optional — handle required only for request attribution + wallet; one field, no email in this build; live availability + reserved-name check
optional — teaches credits vs game dollars over the full pack ladder; top-up is skippable forever
requires balance > 0; recommends camera director 10 cr/30 min (view-layer, zero in-world risk); optional second guided ask demonstrates a DECLINED nudge + 50% auto-refund
optional teaching beat — a fixed-safe nudge scripted to be declined so the player watches the refund land
fork card: 'hire a character' (→ create.html) and 'keep watching' carry equal weight

persona_fork.where: welcome card, before the tour offer
persona_fork.watch_path: tour ends at S1w 'you're set' card; optional items relabeled 'only if you ever want to act'; setup still reachable, never pushed
persona_fork.rule: the fork changes emphasis and checklist labeling only — it never unlocks, hides, or prices anything

tour_beats.note: v25 beat — the honest limit up front: mains unpossessable by anyone, at any tier

tour_rules.skippable: every beat — Skip ends the whole tour
tour_rules.auto_play: never — not on return visits, not after dismissal, not mid-request
tour_rules.overlay: coach-mark card beside the anchored element; never a modal over the stream
tour_rules.reduced_motion: prefers-reduced-motion strips the anchor pulse; the tour itself is click-driven, no animation required

handle_rules.reserved: all main + ambient character names and surnames (characters.json + ambients.json) plus system words (admin, mod, landlord, system, support, owner, realworld, thewire, rw, staff)
handle_rules.reserved_reason: the feed attributes requests by handle — a spectator named 'Victor' would read as the resident; impersonation blocked at input, not by moderation
handle_rules.screening: handles are NOT request text — §11 intent screening does not apply; format + reservation only (character names in creation go through the real screen per creation.json)
handle_rules.on_taken: inline message + suggested variants; never an error page
handle_rules.demo_source: demo carries an inline copy of the reserved list; at merge, reserved names are generated from characters.json + ambients.json

pack_ladder.doc: wallet step shows the full ladder honestly, PROPOSAL prices verbatim — no highlighted 'best value', no decoy styling
pack_ladder.first_purchase_bonus: +50% extra credits once, disclosed on the wallet card — never sprung at checkout

checklist.completes_on: S5 fork chosen (or S1w 'just keep watching' on the watch path)

checklist_rules.optional_items: marked 'optional' in copy ('only if you ever want to act' on the watch path); never styled as failures; percent-complete bars only count chosen (non-skipped) items
checklist_rules.completion_reward: none — completing onboarding grants no credits/items/status (no-dark-patterns)
checklist_rules.done_state: thanks the viewer once, collapses permanently

first_ask_recommendation.why: cheapest (10 cr/30 min), compatible class auto-clears, view-layer only — demonstrates declare→classify→screen→run with zero in-world risk
first_ask_recommendation.alt: possess or nudge offered to players who already hired — nudge copy always states 'the character may decline'
first_ask_recommendation.guided_text: fixed safe text — onboarding does not re-implement the §11 screen; free text lives in request.html
first_ask_recommendation.lifecycle_demo: filed request lands 'running'; a 'jump ahead' affordance resolves it so the player sees the hard cap end the session — nothing billed past the cap

declined_ask_lesson.scripted_outcome: declined — fixed in the demo so every tester sees the refund path
declined_ask_lesson.copy_promise: you pay for the ask, never the outcome
declined_ask_lesson.feed_result: request event resolves 'resolved' with neutral declined wording + refund amount

exit_states.completed: all chosen items done — collapses permanently
exit_states.dismissed: one-click don't-show; no confirm-shame, no snooze timer
exit_states.parked: card closed via ✕ mid-way — reopens only via footer link 'New here? Take the tour'; never auto-resurfaces
exit_states.returning: session 2+ with state (or ?returning=1): no welcome card; a quiet 'welcome back' line at most; footer link only

deep_links.?returning=1: demo affordance simulating a returning session — suppresses the welcome card

never: gate/dim/delay/nag the free feed; no paywall copy
offer or imply possession of C1–C8 at any tier
invent prices/discounts/'limited-time' framing not in plan §2
auto-play the tour on return visits, after dismissal, or mid-request
describe requests as guaranteed outcomes — declined asks are a feature, taught up front
let a spectator handle impersonate a resident
analytics_hooks: plus marketing's spec'd watch_start / request_submitted / character_created where those actions occur
demo_limits: onboarding.html simulates a mini Wire + fork + tour + handle + wallet + guided requests locally; no screen.js call (guided text is fixed-safe); the declined nudge is scripted to decline — real nudge outcomes are never scripted; at merge anchors bind to real feed.html ids, checklist subscribes to gsViewerState, and the reserved-name list is generated from characters.json + ambients.json
